{"metadata":{"description":"Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): graceful restart + client auto-reconnect + cross-restart goal continuation.","id":"gh:1351653568","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-phoenix","slug":"StvLi/dsh-phoenix","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","graceful-restart","plugin","self-evolving","self-healing","watchdog"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): graceful restart + client auto-reco"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nnect + cross-restart goal continuation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🐦 dsh-phoenix"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"### Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-phoenix` is a persistent DeepSeek Harness host plugin that turns **"plugin update → restart dsh"},{"id":"p4s2","text":""** from a disruptive break into a **graceful, seamless, resumable loop** — so a running task finish"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"es, the browser keeps up, and a long-running objective resumes and keeps evolving across restarts."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**English** · 中文版"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why you need it"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is "everything is a plugin," and a dsh Web is a single long-running process managed"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" by *systemd*. That creates three painful realities:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Pain | What dsh-phoenix does |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Updating a plugin means hard-restarting dsh, **cutting off whatever is running** | **Gracefully re"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"starts** — waits until no agent is turning, so the current task finishes before the reboot. |
| Afte"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"r a backend restart the browser page **drops its connection and freezes** ("stopped") | **Auto-recon"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"nects** — a tiny injected heartbeat reloads the page the moment the backend returns. |
| A restart d"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"estroys in-memory goal state, so an objective **cannot continue across restarts** | **Re-arms the go"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"al** — after the reboot it re-activates a disarmed goal so a long-running objective resumes and keep"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"the reboot it re-activates a disarmed goal so a long-running objective resumes and keeps evolving. |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 1. Graceful restart — reboots only when it's safe
- Detects a plugin **(re)activation** through "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"the dsh plugin tools (`cordis_run`) and **does not** restart immediately.
- Checks every live agent "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"(including sub-agents): if any is `running`, it **defers** and re-checks every few seconds, restarti"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ng only when the agent goes **idle** (a 5-minute cap prevents a never-restart).
- Runs the restart t"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"hrough `systemd-run --user` as an **independent transient unit**, so even the process being restarte"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"d survives until the reboot completes.
- React only to `cordis_run` — client bundle source edits tha"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"t dsh's own HMR reloads are not `cordis_run` operations, so they do **not** trigger a dsh-phoenix re"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"'s own HMR reloads are not `cordis_run` operations, so they do **not** trigger a dsh-phoenix reboot."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 2. Client auto-reconnect — the page keeps up with the backend
- Registers a `/__dsh_health` endp"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"oint that returns a **per-boot token**.
- Injects a **zero-dependency heartbeat** into the served in"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"dex: every few seconds it polls `/__dsh_health`; when the token changes (the backend restarted), the"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" page **reloads itself**.
- No more "frozen / stopped" page. Backend restarts become invisible."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 3. Cross-restart goal re-arm — a task keeps evolving
- Goals are durable (session-log backed), b"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ut dsh disarms an active goal on every restart, so automatic continuation stops.
- `dsh-phoenix` rea"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ds a **persistent checkpoint** (a JSON state file); when it says `pendingResume: true`, it finds the"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" live agent's *active + disarmed* goal and calls `goals.resume()` to **re-arm** it.
- Re-armed, the "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"harness's goal round driver continues driving the next iteration."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 🧬 The whole point: a self-evolving loop
Combine the three and you get a **cross-restart autonomo"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"us evolution loop** (reproducible steps in docs/VERIFY.md):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The checkpoint is the loop's durable memory; the goal is its driver; the re-arm hook is its resurrec"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"int is the loop's durable memory; the goal is its driver; the re-arm hook is its resurrection point."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## 🆚 How this is different"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Project | Focus | dsh-phoenix adds |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Complement, not a competitor — two axes, one leak-proof layering"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"#### Axis 1 · the composition (what dsh is made of)
dsh is a Cordis *composition*: a tree of plugin "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rows produced by diffing patch layers. It is applied at boot but **not frozen** — rows can be added,"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" removed or swapped **live** through the loader's diff mechanism. dsh's own HMR (`cordis-plugin-hmr`"},{"id":"p22s4","text":") already hot-reloads this, but it *deliberately ignores `node_modules`*, so **upgrading an already-"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"installed plugin package still needs a restart** — that is exactly the gap the hot family fills."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The **hot family owns this axis**. When you `dsh plugin add/remove/update` a bundle from the CLI, `d"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"sh-hot-installer` watches the profile manifest (`dsh.profile.bundles`) and `dsh-hot-reload` watches "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"`pnpm-lock.yaml`. They drive the *same boot-time mount path* live: resolve the package, read its `ds"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"h.bundle.patch`, inject the rows into the running tree, re-import the new module (cache invalidation"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" + fiber re-instantiation). On failure they **roll back** to the working version and flag "a restart"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" is needed." They never touch the process — **they never restart dsh.**"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 📦 Requirements"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **The graceful-restart feature requires dsh to run as a `systemd --user` service** (d"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"efault unit `dsh-web`). On other setups — macOS, containers without systemd, or `pnpm run dev:web` —"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" the restart is the one feature that cannot work. On those, either set `DSH_PHOENIX_RESTART_CMD` to "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"a command that restarts your dsh process, or accept that only **client auto-reconnect** and **goal r"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"e-arm** are active. The plugin detects this at startup and logs `graceful restart DISABLED` so it ne"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"ver *silently* fails."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- A DeepSeek Harness `dsh` installation whose Web runs as a **systemd --user service** (default unit"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" `dsh-web`).
- Node `>= 22`.
- **Zero external dependencies** — the plugin uses only dsh's own runti"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"me services (`timer`, `webServer`, `agents`, `goals`, `shell`)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 🧠 How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Detect** — subscribes to `tools/result` and reacts to a plugin **(re)activation** (`cordis_run`)"},{"id":"p28s2","text":".
- **Defer** — if any agent is `running`, hold the restart and re-check until idle (or the cap).
- "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"**Reboot** — `systemd-run --user` schedules `stop → sleep → start`, decoupled from the dsh cgroup.
-"},{"id":"p28s4","text":" **Reconnect** — the health endpoint + injected heartbeat reload the page when the boot token change"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"s.
- **Resume** — on boot, reads the checkpoint; if `pendingResume`, re-arms the disarmed goal via `"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"— on boot, reads the checkpoint; if `pendingResume`, re-arms the disarmed goal via `goals.resume()`."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Everything logs `[dsh-phoenix]` to the dsh journal for easy inspection."}],"truncated":true}
